channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by web security and network device ecosystems, characterized by widespread remote code execution, authentication bypasses, and memory corruption flaws. Critical weaknesses impact widely deployed systems including Kubernetes agents, WordPress plugins, MB Connect Line medical infrastructure, and multiple database middleware components, enabling unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges or exfiltrate sensitive data. The recurring patterns of injection attacks, improper authorization controls, and insecure credential handling underscore systemic deficiencies in input validation and access enforcement that demand immediate patching across cloud, on-premises, and IoT environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-114566 — Desktop OS
item.description: Allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via malicious OGM file parsing, requiring only minimal user interaction.

item.title: CVE-2026-109091 — Desktop OS
item.description: Malicious monitors can exploit EDID descriptor handling to crash the X server or achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-111521 — Desktop OS
item.description: A TOCTOU flaw enables local low-privileged attackers to escalate to code execution on Windows desktop environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-64669 — Desktop OS
item.description: pam_usb incorrectly detects remote tmux sessions using an outdated command, potentially bypassing hardware-based authentication policies on Linux workstations.

item.title: CVE-2026-125754 — Desktop OS
item.description: Insecure direct object reference in Dolibarr allows authenticated users to access and view other users' sensitive expense report payment data.

item.title: CVE-2026-125750 — Desktop OS
item.description: Improper authorization guards in Firekylin permit editor-role users to query and extract administrator TOTP secrets and cloud storage credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-129353 — IoT Security
item.description: Enables remote attackers to achieve full device compromise via a stack-based buffer overflow in the authentication CGI.

item.title: CVE-2026-129351 — IoT Security
item.description: Allows remote code execution through an out-of-bounds write in the mini_httpd component during web interface setup.

item.title: CVE-2026-129258 — IoT Security
item.description: Firmware upgrade handler lacks sufficient verification, permitting attackers to flash malicious images remotely.

item.title: CVE-2026-60039 — IoT Security
item.description: High-privileged code injection in the MB Connect Line backup restore function leads to complete system compromise of medical device infrastructure.

item.title: CVE-2026-60044 — IoT Security
item.description: Weak static passwords protecting backup archives on MB Connect Line devices allow unauthenticated remote attackers to exfiltrate sensitive patient data.

item.title: CVE-2026-125076 — IoT Security
item.description: Missing authentication enforcement in the SourceCodester Smart Attendance System API allows unauthorized manipulation of QR code scanner operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-129433 — Cloud Security
item.description: Authenticated organization members can inject shell commands via the serviceName parameter, leading to complete system compromise.

item.title: CVE-2026-121374 — Cloud Security
item.description: Kubernetes special agent argument injection allows rule editors to write arbitrary files and execute code on monitored hosts.

item.title: CVE-2026-120495 — Cloud Security
item.description: Path traversal in synthetic monitoring tests enables attackers to define arbitrary HTML file contents and locations.

item.title: CVE-2026-125330 — Cloud Security
item.description: HarnessRouter fails to enforce workspace scoping for API keys, allowing lateral movement and unauthorized access across isolated workspaces.

item.title: CVE-2026-102289 — Cloud Security
item.description: Debug logging in the zizmor CI/CD analysis tool inadvertently serializes and exposes sensitive environment credentials like GitHub tokens.

item.title: CVE-2026-125758 — Cloud Security
item.description: Aptabase uses a publicly known example AUTH_SECRET, enabling unauthenticated sign-in link forgery and user enumeration.

item.title: CVE-2026-126148 — Network Devices
item.description: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary OS commands via crafted HA join-request packets without any credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-126147 — Network Devices
item.description: Path traversal vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution by manipulating restricted directory paths.

item.title: CVE-2026-126164 — Network Devices
item.description: Blind SQL injection enables unauthenticated attackers to extract sensitive data or execute administrative commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-123039 — Network Devices
item.description: [CISA KEV] Local authenticated users exploit a world-writable socket to execute commands as root, widely exploited in the wild.

item.title: CVE-2026-114713 — Network Devices
item.description: [CISA KEV] IRCv3 label injection allows server-to-server command execution with elevated authority across linked networks.

item.title: CVE-2026-102643 — Network Devices
item.description: AsyncSSH relies on insufficient path normalization, allowing SFTP clients to traverse outside intended directories via crafted relative paths.

item.title: CVE-2026-125401 — Network Devices
item.description: A heap buffer overflow in Ettercap can be triggered by malformed Gadu-Gadu protocol traffic, potentially crashing the sniffer or executing code.

item.title: CVE-2026-124001 — Network Devices
item.description: Integer overflow in NASA JPL ION-DTN's datagram retransmission layer allows heap corruption via maliciously crafted 64-bit length values.

item.title: CVE-2026-124747 — Network Devices
item.description: BusyBox wget fails to validate FTP resume offsets against reported file sizes, creating an integer calculation error exploitable by malicious servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-19907 — Web Security
item.description: Authentication bypass occurs by parsing LOGGED_IN_COOKIE without cryptographic signature verification, enabling account takeover.

item.title: CVE-2026-120522 — Web Security
item.description: Missing authorization checks on upload endpoints allow arbitrary file writes, potentially leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-12591 — Web Security
item.description: Insufficient permission validation in delegated administration allows technicians to escalate privileges and trigger RCE.

item.title: CVE-2026-54831 — Web Security
item.description: Blind SQL injection in the WordPress plugin allows attackers to extract database contents without direct query feedback.

item.title: CVE-2026-124969 — Web Security
item.description: Insufficient path validation in image optimization functions permits arbitrary file deletion, disrupting website assets.

item.title: CVE-2026-126173 — Web Security
item.description: Critical authorization bypass in a widely used WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to reset passwords and fully compromise websites.

item.title: CVE-2026-124079 — Web Security
item.description: Unauthenticated deserialization of untrusted data in rConfig enables arbitrary code execution via its Redis-backed job queue.

item.title: CVE-2026-126065 — Web Security
item.description: OpenObserve accepts empty or whitespace-only passwords for certain accounts, granting unauthenticated access to cloud-native observability dashboards.

item.title: CVE-2026-123800 — Web Security
item.description: A multitenancy permission check bypass in SuperTokens allows attackers to create or update resources outside their authorized tenant scope.

item.title: CVE-2026-125114 — Web Security
item.description: Novu passes unsanitized webhook URLs directly to HTTP clients, enabling SSRF attacks and potential internal network reconnaissance.

item.title: CVE-2026-116323 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Use-after-free in pltcl allows object creators to execute arbitrary code as the database operating system user.

item.title: CVE-2026-116328 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Integer wraparound in memory context generation enables arbitrary code execution via oversized allocation reuse.

item.title: CVE-2026-116330 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Untrusted data inclusion in pg_dump tar restores allows compromised servers to execute code on client machines.

item.title: CVE-2026-120145 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Missing authorization in logical replication permits compromised publishers to run commands as superuser-owned subscriptions.

item.title: CVE-2026-61547 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Heap buffer overflow in rabbitmq-c occurs when serializing oversized AMQP frames, posing a remote code execution risk to message broker clients.

item.title: CVE-2026-112323 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Repeated failed GSSAPI authentication requests in MIT Kerberos allocate unreleased client state, enabling remote denial-of-service against directory services.

item.title: CVE-2026-123817 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: AIOHTTP's WebSocket reader retains excessive memory objects during incomplete frame reassembly, allowing malicious peers to trigger severe resource exhaustion.

item.title: CVE-2026-103813 — Other
item.description: OS command injection in limited-privilege accounts enables privilege escalation to root on the storage appliance.

item.title: CVE-2026-86356 — Other
item.description: Authorization bypass vulnerability allows authenticated users to elevate privileges to administrator level.

item.title: CVE-2026-91879 — Other
item.description: Sensitive information leakage in log files during client initialization exposes configuration details to low-privileged attackers.

item.title: CVE-2026-125269 — Other
item.description: Double free vulnerability in FFmpeg's H.264 SEI parser can be exploited via crafted video streams to crash media players or backend transcoders.

item.title: CVE-2026-124996 — Other
item.description: Out-of-bounds read in the Turboderp ExLlamaV3 AI routing kernel can be triggered by manipulated tensor arguments, risking information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2026-82509 — Other
item.description: The V programming language standard library defaults TLS certificate validation to false, enabling on-path attackers to intercept encrypted HTTPS traffic.
